name: Product Development Agents
description: Backlog, release, and discovery vocabulary + starter questions.
starter_prompts: Summarize top customer feedback themes for the current roadmap cycle
Which epics are at risk given velocity and open blockers?
What shipped in the last release and what feedback did it generate?

terminology.description: A large body of work spanning multiple sprints.
Completed work per sprint — used for forecasting, never as a performance score.
An impediment stopping progress — fan-out target for coordination agents.
Runtime toggle decoupling deploy from release.
Evidence-gathering about user needs before build. AI synthesizes; humans decide.
Accumulated shortcuts with future cost — track explicitly, don't let it hide.
